name: Ohrid
tagline: An ancient lake of churches and clear water
summary: Ohrid is a hillside old town on one of Europe's oldest and deepest lakes. See the little church of St. John at Kaneo on its cliff above the water, walk up to Samuel's Fortress and the Roman theatre, see world-class Byzantine frescoes, swim from rocky coves and visit the springs and monastery of St. Naum.
seasonNote: Summer is warm and busy with swimmers; spring and autumn are calm.
arrival: Ohrid Airport has seasonal flights; buses from Skopje take 3 hours, from Tirana about 3.
gettingAround: Walk the old town; boats and buses to St. Naum.
cashTip: The local money is the denar (about 62 to the euro); cards work in hotels and bigger restaurants, carry cash for small places. Prices here are shown in euros.
foodTip: Ohrid trout (protected; order belvica or farmed trout instead), tavče gravče baked beans and ajvar.
buyTip: Ohrid pearls made from fish-scale lacquer, a town craft.
